summary.headline: Astrological Interrogations, Chapters 131–151
summary.text: Chapter list of astrological interrogations, covering prosperity and misfortune, planetary speeds, lunar degrees and winds, sexual questions, suspicions, slavery, written deliveries, success, illness, royal years and rule, service, requests, outcomes, and the duration of inceptions; folio references run from 117v to 120.
